set.body:
Parent epic: bd-01KXZZZWCEEDVD963AZA40FHE7

Objective:
Deliver the one-shot MVPA vertical slice by composing prepared contrast geometry, response data, multivar canonical effects, existing folds, and FeatureSetPlan traversal.

Scope:
- Add the minimal mvpa-fit dependency on multivar.
- For each run and feature set, accumulate H = Z transpose Z and G = Z transpose X from prepared response blocks; reuse prepared XtX and contrast geometry.
- Construct effect and residual matrices without trial betas or time-by-time projectors.
- Under leave-one-run-out execution, aggregate training moments, fit the canonical direction or invariant subspace, freeze it, and evaluate the held-out effect/residual ratio.
- Return the ordinary scalar feature-set result plus a typed canonical payload and receipts for folds, features, temporal preparation, regularization, and Gale diagnostics.
- Reuse existing feature-set, ROI/searchlight, cancellation, and result traversal machinery. Add no CCA-specific engine.

Reference path:
A materialized dense implementation may exist only in tests or benchmarks as an oracle and execution comparison.

Acceptance:
ROI and searchlight scenarios run end to end; streamed and batch moments agree; explicit dense and one-shot paths agree; held-out perturbations cannot alter training artifacts; and the analysis creates no public or required trial-beta artifact on JVM or JS.
set.title: CCA 3: execute runwise canonical moments through mvpa-fit feature sets
